## Functional summary

This is a **94-amino-acid ribosomal protein uL23**, not 95 aa as stated in the prompt. The sequence is an exact full-length match to reviewed UniProt **Q6F1Z2** from *Mesoplasma florum*; a related uL23 homolog also matched at 78.7% identity. The **Ribosomal_L23 (PF00276)** domain was detected at residues 5–90.

uL23 is a structural protein of the **50S large ribosomal subunit**. The reference annotation describes it as binding 23S rRNA and residing near the polypeptide exit tunnel, where it helps provide a docking site for trigger factor. This supports roles in ribosome structure and translation.

**Sequence-derived estimates:** molecular mass ~10.86 kDa; theoretical pI 9.52; predicted charge at pH 7 of about +4.69; GRAVY −0.44. These estimates assume an unmodified protein and do not account for processing or binding partners.
